will send to it, edit it, delete messages in it, wipe its history, and
(tier 5 only) disperse it. Nothing outside this list is ever written to.

notes: memberIds must NOT include your own ownId — `group create` adds you as owner.

`memberIds`, so keep both accurate. The recreated group gets a NEW
